adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, the new `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` loop does `await createEvent(...)` inside the loop, which serializes calendar API calls per destination/host (lines shown around 334-366). This can increase booking latency for collective events with multiple destination calendars. The adjacent fallback branch (no `credentialId`) still uses `Promise.all(...)`, so the review observation about inconsistent parallelism is grounded. This is a performance/architecture concern rather than a correctness defect.
